market_name: Will 7 Fed rate cuts happen in 2026?

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check whether 2y/10y Treasury yields are actually falling in sympathy; confirm the prediction-market move isn't a thin-liquidity blip.
time_plan.1h: Compare with fed funds futures / SOFR curve to see if rate-cut pricing is shifting across venues.
time_plan.2h: Look for a macro catalyst (weak data, geopolitical shock, Fed speak) that would justify a 7-cut repricing.
time_plan.6h: Reassess whether equities are selling off (recession-driven) vs rallying (goldilocks), which changes the TLT interpretation.
time_plan.12h: Measure realized TLT move vs the 40bps estimate; note whether the prediction-market probability held or reverted.

predictions.reasoning: A sharp rise in the implied probability of 7 Fed cuts (175bps) in 2026 signals expectations of aggressive easing, typically tied to recession/labor-market deterioration or crisis. That pulls the expected policy-rate path lower, which lowers yields and lifts long-duration Treasury prices. TLT is the most direct liquid proxy for a dovish repricing of the Fed path.

predictions.tradable_instrument_name: Invesco DB US Dollar Index Bullish Fund

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Verify DXY and EURUSD direction confirm the dovish-dollar interpretation rather than risk-off dollar bid.
time_plan.1h: Check whether the easing expectation is US-specific or global (global easing would mute the FX move).
time_plan.2h: Scan for risk-off signals (VIX, credit spreads) that could flip the dollar to safe-haven bid.
time_plan.6h: Reassess rate-differential narrative vs other G10 central bank expectations.
time_plan.12h: Compare realized UUP move with estimate; flag if safe-haven dynamics dominated.

predictions.reasoning: Pricing for 7 cuts implies a steeply lower US policy path, narrowing rate differentials versus other central banks and typically weakening the dollar. UUP is a liquid DXY proxy. Signal is weaker than the rates link because crisis-driven easing can trigger safe-haven dollar demand, cutting both ways.

evidence_used: Market question implies a very aggressive 7-cut (175bps) easing path for 2026
Dovish rate-path repricing historically lowers Treasury yields (TLT up) and pressures the dollar (UUP down)
Primary-topic tag 'military_conflict' appears mismatched/noisy for a Fed-cuts market
uncertainty_notes: A rise in 7-cut odds could reflect recession fear, which can trigger safe-haven dollar strength, contradicting the UUP-down thesis
Prediction-market probability for a tail outcome (7 cuts) is low and noisy; small notional moves produce large percent swings without real information
Equity direction is genuinely ambiguous (lower rates bullish vs recession bearish), so no equity call is made

llm_justification.summary: This market measures odds of an extreme dovish Fed path (7 cuts/175bps) in 2026. A sharp increase in that probability would most cleanly map to a dovish rates repricing: long Treasuries up (TLT) and the dollar softer (UUP). Both 12h moves are expected to be small (tens of bps), far below the 700bps tradable threshold, so this is informational rather than actionable. The dollar link is weaker because deep-easing expectations are often recession/crisis-driven, which can paradoxically bid the dollar.
key_assumptions: A move in this market reflects a genuine shift in US rate-cut expectations, not thin-market noise
The easing expectation is US-centric rather than a synchronized global easing
No overwhelming risk-off dynamic that overrides the rate-differential channel
failure_modes: The probability move is already public/priced (rates and FX already reflect it), so no residual asset move
Recession/crisis-driven easing triggers safe-haven dollar strength, reversing the UUP call
Thin prediction-market liquidity makes the implied-probability move meaningless as a signal
The 7-cut strike is a deep tail; small dollar flows create outsized percentage moves that carry no macro information
Proxies (TLT/UUP) capture broad duration and dollar factors, diluting the specific Fed-path signal
llm_justification.why_not_ex_post: The card is timestamped, content-hashed, and never overwritten. Execution must reject any card created after an anomaly's trigger time.
